Package com.signalwire.sdk.security

Class WebhookFilter

java.lang.Object
com.signalwire.sdk.security.WebhookFilter
All Implemented Interfaces:
javax.servlet.Filter
public class WebhookFilter extends Object implements javax.servlet.Filter
Servlet filter that enforces SignalWire webhook signature validation on incoming requests.

Wraps the request in a body-caching wrapper before reading the body so that downstream handlers (including framework parsers) can re-read the same raw bytes. This is the canonical Java framework adapter described in the "Framework adapter" section of porting-sdk/webhooks.md.

Behavior:

  1. Read the raw request body once and cache it.
  2. Extract X-SignalWire-Signature (or X-Twilio-Signature) from the request headers.
  3. Reconstruct the public URL — uses X-Forwarded-Proto / X-Forwarded-Host when trustProxy is set, otherwise falls back to HttpServletRequest.getRequestURL() + HttpServletRequest.getQueryString().
  4. Call WebhookValidator.validateWebhookSignature(String, String, String, String).
  5. On invalid: respond 403 Forbidden and do not call chain.doFilter.
  6. On valid: forward via chain.doFilter with the body-caching request wrapper so downstream handlers can re-read the body.

The filter intentionally does not log the signing key, the incoming signature, or which scheme branch tripped — disclosing those weakens the constant-time defense and gives attackers data to differentiate scheme branches with.

Note: this class targets the javax.servlet API (Servlet 4.x / Tomcat 9 / Jetty 9). Apps on Servlet 5.x / Jakarta EE 9+ should bridge via a javax → jakarta shim or copy this class into their codebase with the import package swapped.

    • WebhookFilter

      public WebhookFilter(String signingKey, boolean trustProxy)
      Construct a filter.
      Parameters:
      signingKey - customer's Signing Key. Required.
      trustProxy - when true, honor X-Forwarded-Proto / X-Forwarded-Host for URL reconstruction. false by default since proxy headers are spoofable; only enable when you control the proxy chain.
